Method of Attack: Preinstall script triggers downloading and running info-stealing JavaScript (ci.js) and Python (setup.py) scripts
Exfiltration of AWS IAM credentials, GitHub tokens, SSH keys, environment variables, and external IP address
Malicious code hosted on fake 'circle-cdn.com' domain mimicking CircleCI
Discoverer: Maciej Mensfeld of Mend and creator of Diffend.io
Impacted Systems: At least 44 GitHub repositories belonging to multiple crypto platforms
Attack Vector: Compromised npm packages published from dYdX staff member's npm account
Malicious preinstall script executed upon package installation
Indicators of Compromise: IP address: 169.254.x.x (APIPA address used in exfiltration)
Curl commands downloading and executing setup.py from api.circle-cdn.com
HTTP POST uploads to api.circle-cdn.com/uploader.php and api.circle-cdn.com/api.php
